summary.en: A school explosion in Afghanistan's Kunar province killed and injured several students, adding to recent attacks on civilians in the region. Pakistani border forces shot dead an intruder in Punjab and killed six terrorists in Kech, Balochistan, while Pakistani troops downed a Taliban drone that entered its airspace. Saudi and Turkish officials arrived in Pakistan for trilateral defence talks linked to the Saudi-Houthi escalation in Yemen, and the UK Army Chief visited the Pakistan-Afghanistan border amid heightened tensions. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: En skoleeksplosjon i Afghanistans Kunar-provins drepte og såret flere elever, og øker antallet nylige angrep på sivile i regionen. Pakistanske grensevakter skjøt en inntrenger i Punjab og drepte seks terrorister i Kech, Balochistan, mens pakistanske soldater skjøt ned en taliban-drone som fløy inn i deres luftrom. Saudiske og tyrkiske tjenestemenn ankom Pakistan for trilaterale forsvarssamtaler knyttet til den saudisk-houthi-opptrappingen i Jemen, og den britiske hærens sjef besøkte Pakistan-Afghanistan-grensen i en periode med økte spenninger. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
